meta.title: How to Run a Restaurant Day

paragraphs: Posted by Lily. Last term, the Explorers ran a restaurant day for the other classes. Chef Lucy helped us, and the day went very well. About forty children ate in our restaurant, and everybody was happy. Now other clubs want to do the same. Here are our instructions in five steps. Please read all the steps before you start.

Step one is to move the furniture. First, move the tables and chairs to the middle of the room. Put four chairs around each table, and leave a wide space to walk. Next, hang a big curtain across one corner of the room. The curtain is the door of the kitchen, and the cooks work behind it. Do not forget to leave a clear path for the waiters.

Step two is to make the menu. Choose three dishes that are easy to make, such as fried rice, a mild curry, and fruit. Write each dish on a card in big letters, and put a card on every table. Use simple words, because the guests are young. Then ask Chef Lucy or another adult to check every recipe.

Step three is to prepare the food. First, wash your hands in the sink with soap for twenty seconds. After that, wash the rice and the vegetables in the sink. An adult cuts the vegetables, because children do not use a knife. Then the adult heats a pan, and a child stirs the rice, the egg, and the vegetables. Keep the other children away from the hot pan. Make the curry in a big pot, and stir it slowly.

Step four is to choose the waiters. Choose three or four children to work in the restaurant. Each waitress and waiter wears a clean apron. A waitress writes each order on a small paper, and she takes it behind the curtain. When the food is ready, the waiter carries it to the table with two hands. Smile, and say thank you to every guest.

Step five is to clean the room. Finally, wash every plate and every pot in the sink. Wipe the tables, and put the chairs back in their places. Take down the curtain and fold it carefully. Check every table one more time, and then close the door. Are you ready to start your restaurant day?

paragraphs.th: เมื่ออาหารพร้อม พนักงานเสิร์ฟชายยกไปที่โต๊ะด้วยสองมือ
